name: 95121 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95121 (San Jose) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95121 (San Jose) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95121 (San Jose) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
